suppress.notes: False positive. Microsoft.SourceLink.GitHub is matched to the generic cpe:/a:github:github CPE (GitHub the hosted service), which carries CVE-2012-2055 — a 2012 GitHub.com mass-assignment issue, unrelated to this build-time-only MSBuild package (PrivateAssets=all; it does not ship in the BricksNet NuGet package).

False positive. CVE-2026-25087 is a use-after-free in Apache Arrow C++ (15.0.0–23.0.0, fixed in C++ 23.0.1), reachable only when reading an Arrow IPC *file* with pre-buffering enabled via the C++-only RecordBatchFileReader::PreBufferMetadata API. The Apache.Arrow NuGet package is the independent, fully managed C# implementation and contains no Arrow C++ code; it is matched only through the shared cpe:/a:apache:arrow CPE. BricksNet also reads IPC *streams* (ArrowStreamReader), never IPC files. Suppressed by CVE id only, so other Arrow CVEs still fail the scan.
